intro.text: Somitos Corp. (“the Company”) was incorporated on March 05, 2025 under the laws of the state of Wyoming. We are a development-stage company focused on providing innovative educational tools through our educational language-learning application. We have purchased an educational application “Ronekt Learning”, which is already working and available as a web application, with users also able to download the APK file for mobile installation. Currently, we have no employees, only our officer and director Mrs. Gvantsa Chumburidze. Our executive and business office is located at 34 Pekini Ave, Tbilisi, Georgia 0160, and our telephone number is +13072416300.
